messages:
Marco (ENG-MGR): Heads-up: planning to promote Jin to L4 effective 2026-06-01. Can we get retro pay if packet lands late?
Leah (People Ops): Quick: HRIS level can be backdated to 6/1 but retro pay requires signed comp-change + packet before payroll cutoff.
Marco (ENG-MGR): What exact items do you need so i avoid follow-ups?
Leah (People Ops): Minimal required: manager rationale (3 bullets), 2 contribution links + 1-line context each, peer feedback excerpt (short), proposed comp (base + bonus %), PeopleSoft ID, requested effective date, manager sign-off.
Marco (ENG-MGR): file name? template?
ops-bot: Use promo template: https://redwood.example.com/internal/promo-template. File name: promo_<FIRST>_<LAST>_<MGR>.pdf
Sam (Payroll): Include DOB and PeopleSoft ID. Cutoff for retro is two business days before payroll run; if missed pay moves to next cycle.
Ivy (Compensation): If proposed base > band max, include comp-exception note and CC comp-approvals. Between midpoint and max, justify in packet for calibration.
Marco (ENG-MGR): Can i tell Jin in a 1:1 before payroll confirms?
Leah (People Ops): Yes for a private 1:1. Please avoid public/team announcements until People Ops confirms HRIS + payroll timing.
Marco (ENG-MGR): Any preferred evidence format?
Leah (People Ops): Short bullets + links (PRs, metrics, customer impact). One or two quoted peer lines. No huge PDFs.
Marco (ENG-MGR): Checklist i can copy?
Leah (People Ops): "- Promo template
- Manager rationale (3 bullets)
- 2 contributions (links + 1-line context)
- Peer feedback excerpt
- Proposed comp (base, bonus %)
- PeopleSoft ID + DOB
- Manager sign-off
- Comp-exception note if > band max"
Marco (ENG-MGR): thanks, i'll drop it in by EOD tomorrow.
Leah (People Ops): Great — ping if you want a quick pre-check. Closing thread.
